title: 'Blue Horseshoe': Tracking 'Big Active'
summary:
Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas discuss the new Bloomberg Intelligence tool 'Blue Horseshoe' on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." The new "Blue Horseshoe" tool lets Bloomberg Terminal users see which stocks the biggest active managers ('Big Active') are buying and selling every day on an aggregate basis.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Spending Rolls On as Tech Wealth Hits Records
summary: Companies are spending billions on AI, but actually getting it into production remains a major challenge. Insight Partners sees forward-deployed engineers as part of the solution: embedding directly with customers to turn AI into working products and workflows. Insight Partners Operating Partner Pablo Dominguez joins to discuss why the firm is launching a dedicated practice to help its portfolio companies build that capability. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple New CEO Ternus Puts Focus Back on Design
summary: Apple's new CEO is putting his own stamp on the company and making design a much bigger priority. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman discusses how John Ternus is taking a hands-on role as Apple prepares a wave of new products in this week's Power On newsletter - also now a podcast. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI ‘Pacing’ Doesn’t Mean Slower Adoption
summary: NEA partner Tiffany Luck says any slowdown in development at the AI frontier doesn’t have to slow adoption across the economy. She argues increasingly powerful models from OpenAI, Anthropic and others are already well ahead of enterprise deployment, leaving a major opportunity for companies that can turn raw intelligence into real-world workflows and measurable returns. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Companies are spending billions on AI, but actually getting it into production remains a major challenge. Insight Partners sees forward-deployed engineers as part of the solution: embedding directly with customers to turn AI into working products and workflows. Insight Partners Operating Partner Pablo Dominguez joins to discuss why the firm is launching a dedicated practice to help its portfolio companies build that capability. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: BofA Sees the End of ‘Easy Money’ Made From the AI-Spending Trade
summary: Investors are likely to find it increasingly hard to make “easy money” by betting on outsized returns from artificial intelligence-linked capital expenditures compared with consumer-driven spending, according to strategists at Bank of America Corp.

title: CH Robinson to Buy RXO for $5.8B in Bet on AI Model
summary: CH Robinson agreed to buy trucking brokerage firm RXO Inc. in a deal centered around a bet that artificial intelligence can help the companies improve efficiency in a challenging freight market. Through a cash-and-stock transaction valued at about $5.8 billion, CH Robinson aims to diversify its business and capitalize on RXO’s abilities in expedited and last-mile delivery. CH Robinson, which has been using AI to transform its operations to become leaner, intends to use the system to extract $300 million of cost savings within two years.  Lee Klaskow, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Transport, Logistics and Shipping Analyst says that the $300 million estimate could be conservative. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gas Prices May Cause Consumers to Be 'Edgy,' Kaiser Says
summary: Stuart Kaiser, head of US equity trading strategy at Citigroup Global Markets, says higher gas prices are causing consumer be "edgy" as we get closer to the holiday season. He also expects CEOs to deliver bullish messages during earnings season. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Can Keep Creating Value After IPO: Fanari
summary: Maggie Fanari, chief executive officer of J. Rothschild Capital Management and an Anthropic investor, says the AI company can continue creating value after going public as it compounds growth over the long term. She also views Anthropic’s focus on AI safety as a strength, arguing that technological development and safeguards need to advance together. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ex-Anthropic Researcher Jacob Coxon Testifies at NYC Council AI Hearing
summary: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon warned that the race to develop artificial intelligence poses risks that the industry itself doesn’t fully understand, at a New York City Council hearing where lawmakers weighed whether to impose their own safeguards on a burgeoning global business.

title: TSMC in Talks to Join Musk’s Texas Terafab Project
summary: Elon Musk confirmed that TSMC and his companies are discussing a possible chipmaking partnership in Texas. The project could make TSMC a supplier to Tesla, SpaceX and xAI. Carmen Reinicke has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Schneider Expands in AI With $23 Billion Acquisition
summary: Bloomberg's Liana Baker discusses Schneider Electric’s roughly $23 billion cross-border acquisition of software firm PTC, describing it as the French company’s largest deal and a strategic push into industrial software. She speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Tech Billionaires Make Up 36% of Bloomberg Index
summary: The world's tech billionaires made a combined $845 billion through Sept. 30. US tech billionaires make up 36% of the newly relaunched Bloomberg Billionaires Index. Elon Musk tops the list. Bloomberg's Dylan Sloan reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CH Robinson to Buy RXO in $5.8 Billion Logistics Deal
summary: CH Robinson Worldwide agreed to buy trucking brokerage firm RXO  in a deal centered around a bet that artificial intelligence can help the companies improve efficiency in a challenging freight market. Liana Baker has more on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Skydance's Big Bet: Streaming, Debt, and AI
summary: Michael J. Wolf, co-founder and CEO of Activate joined Bloomberg Open Interest to break down the $110B Skydance–Paramount merger, how cable still "banks" streaming, and why AI is reshaping costs, jobs, and growth across corporate America, before the real gains ever hit the bottom line. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Lockheed’s Fabled Skunk Works Integrates AI in Push to Modernize Defense
summary: The defense contractor’s development unit is key to the company’s future success

title: BT TalkTalk Deal to Test UK Regulator’s Competition Rhetoric
summary: BT Group Plc’s purchase of TalkTalk — the UK’s fourth-biggest broadband provider and a key customer — puts the nation’s competition regulator in a tough spot.

title: AI Billionaires Drive $845 Billion Surge in Wealth This Year
summary: AI brings a staggering new peak in wealth – and signs we just passed it.

title: Why Treasuries Are ‘Risky’ Again
summary: We all know that Treasury yields have been surging, alongside bond yields all around the world. So what explains the selloff and does it mean that bonds are becoming fundamentally riskier? What happens if investors can no longer hedge stocks with government debt? And how do expectations of the Federal Reserve's "reaction function" fit in? In this episode, we speak with Carolin Pflueger, associate professor at the University of Chicago and a resident scholar at the Chicago Fed, about her work on the bond market and central banks. We discuss why bonds have become more stock-like, what that means for yields, and the role of the Fed's credibility in making bonds “bond-like” again. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Whistleblowers, Google, OpenAI, Meta to Face New York City Council
summary: Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who warned that artificial intelligence could become too powerful for humans to control, will testify Monday at a New York City Council hearing alongside representatives of some of the world’s biggest AI companies.
